label: the crawler (models/headcrab.mdl): a sludge crawler: low, wet, six-legged, the size of a headcrab, grey-green with a pale belly and a ring of teeth

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/chumtoad.mdl, models/roach.mdl, models/leech.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked C, D, D, A where the asset was B, B, B, D: passed for one of the game's
measured.contract: keeps the headcrab's bones, animations, attachments and bodyparts

M1.reason: The side, front, back and top views read as a low, wet-looking dome with legs splayed out beneath it, matching the brief's low crawler the size of a headcrab. The outline has no part sticking out or missing in any of the ten views.

M2.reason: Measured size is 14.2 x 23 x 16.9. The brief asks for a long of 25.9, and the 23 long is 11.3% under, inside the 15% band.

M3.reason: The brief names six legs, a ring of teeth and a pale belly. The below and front views show six legs (three each side). The front and front-left views show the ring of about ten pale teeth around the dark mouth, and the side and below views show the pale belly plate under the dome. Nothing named is missing. The small matte skin details are not named parts.

M4.reason: Body is grey-green and the underside is pale, as the brief asks. The mouth is dark maroon and the teeth are pale, both in place. The skin reads as matte, so the wet quality the brief names is under-expressed (charged to M5, not here).

M5.reason: The brief's 'wet' is not visible: the skin is a faint mottle on flat-shaded facets, with no gloss, sheen or glistening at the size the game shows it. The pale belly and teeth are plain flat shapes. Surface detail is thin against the brief's wet look.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 for this reading. In the line-up the asset (the green crawler at C) was picked as the non-Valve model only once in four readings (the D reading), so the judges mostly took it for one of the game's.

M7.reason: The mouth is at the front in the front, left and back-left views, and the body stands upright on its six legs on the floor line in the walk frames. Its origin sits on the floor as a standing creature's does.

M8.reason: SMAK check errors list is empty. Triangles are 438, under twice the Half-Life median of 308 (616). Underside, top and sides read closed, legs visibly attached to the body in the side and below views, nothing floating. The mouth is a dark cavity seen only from the front, as Valve's headcrab shows its own mouth.

C1.reason: Through the walk frames (0 to 34) and the leap frames (0 to 30) the legs stay attached to the body and move with it, and the pale belly stays under the dome. No part visibly comes apart, sinks or floats at the resolution shown.

C2.reason: The measured contract is kept: the headcrab's bones, animations, attachments and bodyparts are all there, so the game's own headcrab plays it.
